classification.difficultyReason: Locate both crossings at 300 m, interpret the interval between them as satisfying 'or more', and subtract the times to obtain a duration.

content.prompt: An object is projected vertically into the air. For how long is the object at a height of 300 m or more above the ground?

spec.description: Black supplied parabola, labelled equation, one-second subdivisions, 50-metre height ticks, solid major grid and dotted intermediate grid. Width increased to retain equation and tick legibility.
spec.mathematics: h=-5t^2+80t for 0≤t≤16; vertex (8,320); h=300 at t=6 and t=10; grid 0≤t≤17 and 0≤h≤400.
spec.answerVisibility: Given curve remains visible; no response interval is marked on the student graph.

answer.worked:
The line $h=300$ meets the curve at $t=6$ and $t=10$. The object is at least $300\text{ m}$ high between these times.
$\begin{aligned}\text{Duration}&=10-6\\\text{Duration}&=4\text{ s}\end{aligned}$
